description.value: The study examined whether segmented gray matter volumes obtained from high-resolution structural MRI predicted executive function and global cognitive mental status in alcohol-dependent outpatients.

spans.text: Thus, the aim of this study was to search for volumetric measurements of segmented brain structures obtained from high-resolution MRI that could be predictive of executive functions and cognitive mental status in alcoholic subjects.
